verdict.rationale: The evidence shows list and retrieve endpoints (stakeholders, option grants, convertible notes), single-item creation of draft option grants and issuers, and read-only SQL analytics in the data warehouse. None of this documents a bulk or batch operation that creates, updates or acts on many items at once. Paginated reads and analytical queries are adjacent features, not bulk operations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
